punchline: Joshua Foer went to the national memory championship as a reporter and won it a year later.
thirty_sec: Joshua Foer covered the 2005 U.S. Memory Championship as a journalist and met English grandmaster Ed Cooke, who offered to coach him. After about a year of training he won the 2006 title with a U.S. record: one deck of cards in 1 minute 40 seconds. His book argues that memory is a trainable skill.
